entries.symptom: Pacman reports existing NVIDIA firmware paths during the firmware package split.
entries.mitigation: Review the distribution's migration notice before upgrading across the split.
entries.retire_when: The installed firmware package has crossed the split.

entries.symptom: A systemd-hook migration can change PCR values 0–7, 9 and 12–14 used by a TPM2 unlock policy.
entries.mitigation: Check the actual enrolled PCR policy and a working recovery credential before rebuilding. Follow the official notice if those PCRs are pinned.
entries.retire_when: An administrator verifies unlocking with the new measurements.
